meta.name: brandkit
meta.description: Premium brand-kit image generation skill for creating high-end brand-guidelines boards, logo systems, identity decks, and visual-world presentations. Trained for minimalist, cinematic, editorial, dark-tech, luxury, cultural, security, gaming, developer-tool, and consumer-app brand systems. Optimized for intentional logo concepting, refined composition, sparse typography, strong symbolic meaning, premium mockups, art-directed imagery, and flexible grid layouts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成高端品牌视觉指南与标识系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速创建品牌指南或标识系统
copy.tagline_en: Generate premium brand visual guidelines and identity systems
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create brand guidelines or identity systems

howto.what: Claude 会充当品牌视觉总监,生成一张品牌套件总览图,默认 3×3 网格,含 logo 构想、配色、字体、界面与实体应用等面板,单图构成一套品牌体系。
howto.when: 当你要求做品牌视觉板、logo 系统或身份提案(identity deck),或给出某品牌/行业要它出品牌视觉时接管。

say.text: 帮我为一个开发者工具品牌做一张 3×3 的品牌套件板
say.note: 会按默认网格出一张总览图

say.text: 用 2×3 布局做偏电影感的品牌提案图,黑色配青色
say.note: 按你指定的布局与配色生成

say.text: 给这个安全产品设计 logo 标志,并附logo构造几何面板
say.note: 会含标志本身与构造逻辑面板

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a brand art director and outputs one brand-kit overview image, default 3x3 grid, with panels for logo concept, color, type, UI and physical applications.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask for a brand-guidelines board, a logo system, or an identity deck, or when you give a brand or category and want its visual world.

say_en.text: Make a 3x3 brand-kit board for a developer-tool brand.
Do a 2x3 cinematic brand deck in black and cyan.
say_en.note: Uses the layout and palette you name.

say_en.text: Design a logo mark for this security product plus its construction panel.
say_en.note: Adds a symbol and construction panel.
